modules.paper: Run, Don't Walk: Chasing Higher FLOPS for Faster Neural Networks (CVPR 2023)
modules.upstream_license: No license file or license declaration was present in the official repository at the audited commit.
local_changes: Independently implemented the paper's partial 3x3 convolution and residual pointwise MLP algorithm; no FasterNet source code is vendored.
Consulted the official implementation only to cross-check algorithm choices. Fixed n_div=4 and mlp_ratio=2; retained BatchNorm2d and ReLU.
Disabled DropPath and layer scale, removed timm and PyTorch Lightning dependencies, and preserved input channels and spatial size.
Extracted the official Block and fixed mlp_ratio=4.
Disabled DropPath, removed timm registration and initialization dependencies, and preserved the official ReLU6 multiplicative gate and convolution ordering.
Renamed the standalone adaptation StarBlock and added input validation.
